verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own marketing says users can "set up automation rules and have it handled exactly how you want," and it points to an official Zapier connection and an API for workflow control. That is a first-party rule-automation capability, but it rests on one-line claims with no detail on which events trigger rules or which actions they can run. Missing for 10: documented rule triggers/events and available actions, rule configuration docs, any public API/OpenAPI reference (probes 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
